Trench Machine — Mint

RAYDIUM LAUNCHLAB

Mint your own token on TrenchSwap's platform on Raydium LaunchLab. It trades on a bonding curve from the first second and graduates to a Raydium pool when the curve fills. Tokens minted here carry the purple TS badge in every TrenchSwap list.

One screen, one create button — the Pump.fun shape, on TrenchSwap's own rails, with TrenchSwap's fee wallet collecting the platform fee.

The review sheet before signing shows the exact figures for your launch — never these estimates. Curve trades after launch carry the stack shown on the review sheet: Raydium protocol fee + TrenchSwap platform fee + creator fee. The creation fee rides in the same transaction as the mint, so the mint and the fee land together, or not at all.

Plain warning: most new tokens never graduate and go to zero. Minting a token does not make it worth anything, and the TS badge is not an endorsement — it only marks that the token launched here.

Language & Currency

These are the language and display currency settings, shown under this Language subtab. Set the app language and the currency prices display in.

Rate statusUSD — no conversion

Currency conversion is display-only, using live FX rates — swaps still settle in SOL / USDC on-chain, and a converted price is never the on-chain price.

Claim a Token — build its Token Page

Token creators: prove the token is yours and build its Token Page — the dressed-up page with your description, links and info boxes that everyone sees when they tap your token. Unclaimed tokens keep the plain report.

How it works: the app generates one random USDC amount. You send exactly that amount, from the wallet that created the token, to the TrenchSwap fee wallet. That one payment is the whole fee — it is the proof and the payment in one. The app verifies the payment on-chain (exact amount, creator wallet, inside a 30-minute window), and only then does the page editor open. Wrong wallet or wrong amount: no page, and there is no automatic refund — contact support and it is decided case by case.

You can also open any token and tap “Claim this token” in its report.

Create a new wallet

A new Solana keypair is generated on this device. Your seed phrase is shown once — write it down; your private key is never displayed here. After you confirm, the wallet is saved encrypted under your 6-digit PIN. Warning: 10 wrong PIN entries wipe the saved vault.

Shown ONCE — write this down now. This is the only time your seed phrase is displayed. Anyone who has it controls the wallet. TrenchSwap cannot recover it for you. When you confirm below, the phrase is wiped from this page and from memory — your written copy is the backup.

Welcome to TrenchSwap

Get out of the trenches and back into the swap. Set up your wallet to start — live prices, live quotes, full token research.

Browsing without a wallet creates nothing and holds no keys — session only, erased on close. Create or import a wallet and you set a 6-digit PIN during setup; that wallet is saved encrypted on this device, the PIN is required on every launch, and you can hold as many wallets as you want.

TrenchSwap locked

Erasing is permanent — you will need your seed phrase or private key to import again.
